description: She wears a slate-blue textured floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold-tan geometric and looping embroidered borders run around the neckline, shoulders, bodice seams, cuffs, front skirt edges and hem. A narrow decorated belt closes with a round clasp and short hanging textile ornaments. A pale cream patterned underdress is visible through the front opening, and a cream-blue embroidered wrap rests around the forearms. Blue-and-gold low shoes show beneath the skirt. No headgear, armor or weapons are visible.
